start: A member who follows a plan (3 routine days and a rest day), Workout tab

steps.action: Tap 'Log a past workout'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Log a past workout'
'Pick the day, when it started and how long it lasted.'
Question 'Which routine?' with one chip per routine day of the followed plan, in plan order, and a chip 'None'
must_not: A rest day offered as a routine
Routines of a plan that is no longer followed

steps.action: Tap a routine chip, then tap it again
user_sees: The chip is picked, then un-picked (back to not said)
must_not: Two chips picked at once

steps.action: Pick the routine again and tap 'Log <day> · <hh:mm>'
user_sees: The workout editor opens with that routine's exercises in the plan's order
must_not: An exercise missing from the day with no word
Exercises in another order than the plan

start: A member who follows a plan, Today screen

steps.action: Open the Today screen
user_sees: Today's workout card for the next plan day in rotation, with its exercises and targets
must_not: A day of another plan
A rest day shown as a workout

steps.action: Finish that workout, come back to Today
user_sees: The next plan day in rotation
must_not: The same day offered again after it was done

start: A member who never picked a plan (new install)

steps.action: Tap 'Log a past workout'
user_sees: The sheet without the 'Which routine?' question
must_not: An error, an empty chip row or an endless spinner

steps.action: Fill the day, start time and minutes, tap 'Log …'
user_sees: The editor opens empty
must_not: The sheet stuck because no plan exists

start: A member who follows a plan; the plan is switched to another one

steps.action: In Routines, follow another plan
user_sees: The new plan shown as followed
must_not: Two plans active at once

steps.action: Tap 'Log a past workout'
user_sees: 'Which routine?' chips of the new plan only
must_not: The old plan's routines still offered

steps.action: Delete a custom exercise used in a routine day, then open that day
user_sees: The day without that exercise
must_not: A crash or a blank day
